[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (a b: Int) : Int :=
  let a_unit := a % 10
  let b_unit := b % 10
  if a_unit = 0 ∨ b_unit = 0 then 0
  else
    let product := a * b
    let result := product % 100
    if result % b_unit = 0 then result / b_unit % 100
    else 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma mod_unit_digit_product
(a b: Int)
: (a % 10) * (b % 10) % 100 = (a * b) % 100 :=
by
simp [Int.mod]

lemma div_unit_digit_product
(a b: Int)
(h: (a % 10) * (b % 10) % 100 = 0)
: ((a * b) / (b % 10)) % 100 = (a % 10) :=
by
simp [Int.div, Int.mod]

lemma unit_digit_zero_product
(a b: Int)
(h: (a % 10) = 0 ∨ (b % 10) = 0)
: (a * b) % 100 = 0 :=
by
cases h
  case or.inl h_a0
  simp [h_a0]
  case or.inr h_b0
  simp [h_b0]

lemma unit_digit_non_zero_product
(a b: Int)
(h: (a % 10) ≠ 0 ∧ (b % 10) ≠ 0)
: (a * b) % 100 ≠ 0 :=
by
have h_a0: (a % 10) ≠ 0 := by
  simp [h.right.left]
have h_b0: (b % 10) ≠ 0 := by
  simp [h.right.right]
have h_product_non_zero: (a * b) % 100 ≠ 0 := by
  have h_a0': 0 < a % 10 := by
    linarith [h_a0]
  have h_b0': 0 < b % 10 := by
    linarith [h_b0]
  have h_product_non_zero': (a * b) % 100 ≠ 0 := by
    simp [Nat.ne_of_gt h_a0' h_b0']
  simp [h_product_non_zero']
exact h_product_non_zero

lemma product_eq_zero
(a b: Int)
(h: (a % 10) * (b % 10) % 100 = 0)
: a * b = 0 :=
by
simp [Int.mul, Int.mod]
